metadata.name: merces_registry
metadata.description: Merces charter and terms registry (D1) plus allowlist, attestor and verifier-key registries (D11). Deployed immutable.

instructions.name: amend_terms
docs: Issuer-favourable amendment (SPEC §3.2, brief C4): the issuer signs the transaction and an
active attestor signs the `MERCES_AMEND_V1` message with the current nonce. The cap
multiple may only decrease. Allowed only while `terminal_status == 0`.

accounts.name: stablecoin_mint
docs: The settlement stablecoin (SPL Token or Token-2022); decimals and owner are read from it.

accounts.name: fx_pair
docs: Required when `fx_pair_id != 0`.

instructions.name: deactivate_issuer
docs: Blocks *new* series only; existing series are untouched (SPEC §3.2).

instructions.name: init_protocol
docs: Creates `ProtocolConfig` once (SPEC §3.2).

instructions.name: mark_curve_activated
docs: Curve-mode activation (SPEC §9; the Meteora integration is a later track). Records the DBC
accounts and fixes `P0` and `units_sold` for cap accounting. Draft → Settled, mint finalised.

instructions.name: mark_mint_finalized
docs: Mint finalised: every bid of a Settled or Failed raise processed and the mint authority
revoked (a failed raise finalises an empty mint, so nothing can ever be minted for it).

instructions.name: mark_raise_opened
docs: Draft → Open. Also enforces the D1 gate: contract hash set, issuer allowlisted, raises not
paused. Records the unit mint and the protocol's unit escrow ATAs for the hook.

instructions.name: mark_raise_result
docs: Records the raise outcome, exact and written once (SPEC §3.2).

instructions.name: mark_terminal
docs: Terminal status mirror: Retired / Redeemed / Extinguished. Extinguished may follow Retired
or Redeemed (SPEC §6.9: allowed in every status but Extinguished).

instructions.name: register_attestor
docs: Registers (or re-activates) an attestor key.

instructions.name: revoke_attestor
docs: Forward-only revocation (SPEC §1.4): records `revoked_at`; refused for the last active key.

instructions.name: set_contract_hash
docs: Draft only, non-zero (SPEC §3.2).

instructions.name: set_defaults
docs: Edits the defaults for *future* series only (bounds-checked).

instructions.name: set_early_draw_approver
docs: `Pubkey::default()` unsets the approver (early draws off).

instructions.name: set_fx_crosscheck
docs: Changes a pair's cross-check feed (SPEC §3.1). Setting it from zero applies from the current
period (nothing was checked before); any later change — a new feed or removal — applies from
`period_of(now) + 1`, and the feed in force for the running period is kept in
`prev_crosscheck`, so a live quarter's rule never changes under an issuer.

instructions.name: set_fx_pair
docs: Registers an FX pair, write-once (SPEC §3.1): `pair_id = keccak256(feed_id ‖ inverted)`
commits to the feed and its direction, and a pair can never be re-registered
(`FxPairImmutable`). A cross-check feed given here applies from the current period; later
changes go through `set_fx_crosscheck`. `enabled` only gates new series.

instructions.name: set_fx_pair_enabled
docs: Enables or disables an existing pair (`enabled = false` only stops new series from
referencing it; live series keep their pair, SPEC §3.1).

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not authorised for this instruction

errors.name: NotProtocolAuthority
errors.msg: Caller is not the protocol authority PDA

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: Caller is not the pending admin

errors.name: AllowlistEntryMismatch
errors.msg: Allowlist entry does not belong to this wallet

errors.name: InvalidReleaseSchedule
errors.msg: Release schedule must have 1..=24 tranches, bps summing to 10000, non-decreasing offsets

errors.name: InvalidTierFlags
errors.msg: Tier flags must be non-zero and use only bits 0..=3

errors.name: FxPairMismatch
errors.msg: FX pair account missing, disabled or does not match fx_pair_id

errors.name: TransferFeeNotZero
errors.msg: Stablecoin mint has a non-zero transfer fee

errors.name: InvalidStablecoinMint
errors.msg: Stablecoin mint could not be read

errors.name: NotDraft
errors.msg: Series is not in Draft state

errors.name: ContractHashNotSet
errors.msg: Contract hash is not set; the raise cannot open

errors.name: NotSealedBid
errors.msg: Series is not a sealed-bid series

errors.name: NotCurveMode
errors.msg: Series is not a curve-mode series

errors.name: AttestorMismatch
errors.msg: Recovered signer is not the supplied attestor address

errors.name: LastKeyOfKind
errors.msg: The last active key of a kind cannot be revoked without a replacement

errors.name: FxPairImmutable
errors.msg: feed_id and inverted are write-once for an FX pair

errors.name: CrosscheckUnchanged
errors.msg: The cross-check feed is already the requested one

errors.name: WalletCapTooSmall
errors.msg: Wallet cap allows no bid: floor(units_offered × wallet_cap_bps / 10000) < 1

errors.name: Tier1TermsRequired
errors.msg: Tier-1 series must supply plaintext router terms

errors.name: Tier1NeedsStablecoinIncome
errors.msg: Tier-1 series must use stablecoin income (fx_pair_id = 0)

errors.name: Tier1ShareTooLarge
errors.msg: Tier-1 series require r_wad × units_offered ≤ WAD

errors.name: Tier1TermsMismatch
errors.msg: Tier-1 terms do not hash to terms_commitment

errors.name: Tier1TermsUnexpected
errors.msg: Router terms supplied for a series without tier 1

errors.name: BoundCommitDuration
errors.msg: commit_duration out of bounds [1 h, 30 d]

errors.name: BoundRevealDuration
errors.msg: reveal_duration out of bounds [1 h, 7 d]

errors.name: BoundWindowCommitDuration
errors.msg: window_commit_duration out of bounds [1 h, 14 d]

errors.name: BoundWindowRevealDuration
errors.msg: window_reveal_duration out of bounds [1 h, 7 d]

errors.name: BoundMaxPause
errors.msg: max_pause_seconds out of bounds [30 d, 730 d]

types.name: AllowlistEntry
docs: Allowlist entry (`[ALLOW, wallet]`). A missing account means "never allowlisted".

types.name: AttestorKey
docs: Attestor key (`[ATTESTOR, addr20]`). `revoked_at == 0` while active (SPEC §1.4).

types.name: CreateSeriesArgs
docs: Arguments to `create_series`. Fees, FX bounds and pause bounds are copied from
`ProtocolConfig.defaults`; everything here is issuer-chosen within the §1.6 bounds.

fields.name: tier1_terms
docs: Required when bit0 (tier 1 split) is set; must hash to `terms_commitment`.

types.name: FxPairConfig
docs: FX pair configuration (`[FX, pair_id]`), `pair_id = keccak256(feed_id ‖ inverted_u8)`.

fields.name: crosscheck
docs: Cross-check feed: on Solana a second Pyth feed id (32 bytes stored as a `Pubkey`); zero when
none is configured.

fields.name: crosscheck_effective_period
docs: Period from which `crosscheck` applies (SPEC §3.1).

fields.name: prev_crosscheck
docs: The cross-check in force before `crosscheck_effective_period` (a change never alters the rule
of a running quarter).

types.name: InitProtocolArgs
docs: Arguments to `init_protocol`.

fields.name: chain_id
docs: Cluster tag (SPEC §1.3): mainnet-beta 101, testnet 102, devnet 103, localnet 104.

fields.name: protocol_program
docs: The `merces_protocol` program id whose `[REGISTRY_AUTHORITY]` PDA may call the write
interface. Fixed for the life of the deployment (no setter).

types.name: Issuer
docs: Issuer record (`[ISSUER, wallet]`).

types.name: ParametersData
docs: Borsh-serialisable mirror of [`Parameters`].

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Global protocol configuration, one per deployment (`[CONFIG]`).

fields.name: domain
docs: `keccak256(1u8 ‖ chain_id_be ‖ registry_program_id)` (SPEC §1.3).

fields.name: early_draw_approver
docs: Zero when unset (early draws off).

fields.name: protocol_program
docs: The `merces_protocol` program id, fixed at init (no setter).

fields.name: protocol_authority
docs: `find_program_address([REGISTRY_AUTHORITY], protocol_program)`: the only key allowed to call
the write interface (SPEC §3.2 `registry_authority`).

fields.name: attestor_count
docs: Active key counts (a kind's last active key cannot be revoked, SPEC §1.4).

types.name: Series
docs: One raise by one issuer (`[SERIES, series_id_le]`). The charter block is frozen once
`raise_state != Draft` (SPEC §3.3).

fields.name: stablecoin_program
docs: The stablecoin mint's owner program (SPL Token or Token-2022).

fields.name: unit_mint
docs: Set by `mark_raise_opened` (sealed bid) or `mark_curve_activated` (curve).

fields.name: router_theta
docs: Tier-1 plaintext terms (zero unless bit0 of `tier_flags` is set).

types.name: Tier1Terms
docs: Plaintext tier-1 terms (public by the issuer's choice, SPEC §6.5); checked against
`terms_commitment` with Poseidon(5) at series creation.

fields.name: terms_salt
docs: The commitment salt as a 32-byte big-endian field element.

types.name: TrancheData
docs: Borsh-serialisable mirror of [`Tranche`].

types.name: VerifierKey
docs: Report-verifier key (`[VERIFIER, addr20]`).
